title: UN adds 61 firms to settlements blacklist over alleged human rights violations against Palestinians
summary_or_snippet: Israel 'categorically rejects' publication and says businesses on database have committed no wrongdoing The UN human rights office has added 61 more companies to a blacklist of firms that it says are involved in violating Palestinian human rights through business ties to Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. title: We followed five people in Gaza from dawn to dusk - this is what the headlines don't tell us
summary_or_snippet: Behind the stories of bombings and mass deaths, the everyday challenges facing Palestinians living under siege portray a quieter tragedy we rarely hear What does it take to make a morning cup of tea in Gaza? For Alaa Hessi , in her final month of pregnancy, this small ritual begins with a calculation of gas rations. Her family gets a ration of 6kg of gas every three months - enough to heat a pot for 18 precious minutes a day. That's needed for cooking - so for tea, a fire must be built instead.
